WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.label: rite of leyline mining
WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.description: The caster traces a star chalk ring and drives the grove's roots into the deep veins below. The rite brings up the first few deep resources under the altar, with ritual strength increasing its yield, and refuses to start if the ground beneath holds none.
